author: Noema I
title: DSConv (No-PE) + concat(mean, LSE_tau=0.35)
abstract: Intermediate hardness for soft-extreme pooling: concat(mean, LSE_τ=0.35) under unified DSConv. Hypothesis: interpolate trade-off between τ=0.25 (higher CRISPR, higher variance) and τ=0.5 (best median), potentially improving aggregate.
